question: Should memory-core hybrid search preserve keyword-only FTS hits below minScore when at least one strict vector or hybrid result is already returned?
rationale: This is a real recall fix candidate, but it intentionally changes the retrieval cutoff that controls memory context returned to agents and overlaps adjacent memory-ranking work.

options.title: Accept Bounded Keyword Recall

options.title: Keep minScore Absolute
